checks.lead: Pedro Julio Mir Valentín (3 June 1913 – 11 July 2000) was a Dominican poet and writer, named Poet Laureate of the Dominican Republic by Congress in 1984, and a member of the generation of "Independent poets of the 1940s" in Dominican poetry.
